name: qwen-coder
description: Lightweight agentic coding assistant powered by your local Qwen3-Coder via llama.cpp. Like Claude Code / Copilot, but 100% local.

qwenCoder.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your llama.cpp server (run with --jinja).

qwenCoder.model.description: Model name sent in the request (llama.cpp ignores it, but some servers require it).

qwenCoder.temperature.description: Lower = more decisive (good for agent/coding). 0.2 recommended.

qwenCoder.maxIterations.description: Max tool-call iterations per request before the agent stops.

qwenCoder.autoApproveCommands.description: Run shell commands WITHOUT asking. Leave OFF for safety (assisted mode).

qwenCoder.apiKey.description: Optional bearer token if your endpoint requires auth.
